text.paragraph: Primary care visit for low mood, exhaustion, and poor sleep after returning from a long humanitarian deployment. tr.td: Primary care visit for low mood, exhaustion, and poor sleep after returning from a long humanitarian deployment
Two-week sertraline tolerability and safety check, with psychiatry consultation
Five-month depression review in continuation treatment
Same-day sick visit for low back pain after lifting

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

tr.td: Shared decision-making: combined psychotherapy and an antidepressant for a recurrent, moderately severe episode; she chose cognitive behavioral therapy and sertraline
Start sertraline 50 mg each morning; check tolerability and safety at two weeks; increase to 100 mg if the PHQ-9 has fallen by less than 50 percent after four to six weeks
Weekly cognitive behavioral therapy with the clinic psychologist, by video or in person, for about 16 sessions, including behavioral activation and insomnia components
Collaborative safety plan with warning signs, coping steps, people to contact, the clinic number, and the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline; medicines stored safely and dispensed in 30-day supplies
Psychiatry consultation to confirm the diagnosis, exclude bipolar disorder and PTSD, and advise on treatment of a recurrent episode
PHQ-9 at every visit and at least monthly until remission; suicide-risk review at every visit; continue sertraline for at least twelve months after remission because the episode is recurrent

Burnout and work: two weeks of medical leave, then a phased return with a 45-hour cap, no field deployment for at least six months, delegation of the families' correspondence, and a peer support group for relief workers

Sleep and activity: fixed wake time, no work after 8 pm, a daily 30-minute walk, regular meals, and limited alcohol; prolonged bed rest or withdrawal from activity is explained as unhelpful for depression
Screen for bipolar disorder, PTSD, anxiety, and unhealthy alcohol use, and check thyroid, blood count, vitamin B12, and a metabolic panel for medical contributors to fatigue
Response (PHQ-9 down by at least 50 percent) by twelve weeks
PHQ-9 7 at twelve weeks, down 61 percent from 18
Remission (PHQ-9 below 5) and continuation treatment for at least twelve months after remission
Remission reached at five months (PHQ-9 4); continuation treatment under way
Sleep at least six hours most nights
About six and a half hours most nights by twelve weeks
Phased return to work at no more than 45 hours a week, with no field deployment for at least six months
Full duties at 45 hours a week from April; no deployment
Time with friends or her faith community at least twice a week
Weekly dinner with friends and weekly services

list.item: At intake, still working but taking twice as long over letters and reports, eating little, and withdrawing from friends [S]

text.paragraph: Structured synthetic safety assessment on 2026-01-20: current ideation absent, intent absent, plan absent. Outpatient care with a collaborative safety plan, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, safe storage of medicines, and a two-week follow-up [S]
